observations: Photo 0 shows a diesel engine top cover with readable text: “DAF 24 VALVE” and “DAF” on the valve cover area.
Photo 0 also shows an engine bay with multiple hoses/pipes; surfaces look dusty/used; no obvious fresh paint.
Photo 1 shows a larger view of the engine laid out under a cloth cover; visible turbo/air intake area and many components; no clear model/engine code visible.
Photo 2 shows the full engine laid out; two valve covers appear to be DAF-branded; overall condition looks used with grime and wear consistent with removal/storage.

claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine, in excellent condition and ready for work.
claims.evidence: Photos show a used engine with dust/grime and no running/test evidence (no start video, no compression/leak test).
No performance data (dyno/road test) or running condition shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not be complete (missing sensors, wiring, fuel system parts, or ancillary components). Photos show many parts but completeness cannot be confirmed remotely.
risks.proof: A photo checklist laid out: all engine sensors/ECU, starter, alternator, turbo, injectors, fuel lines, intake/exhaust manifolds, and any removed accessories—plus a close-up of the engine ID plate/engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used engine that may be incomplete/needs parts.

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (may have faults, low compression, injector issues, or oil/coolant leaks).
risks.proof: Short video of a cold start and idle (or at least cranking with RPM), plus a scan/OBD fault code screenshot if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to run (worst case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Wrong engine variant for the buyer’s trailer/head application (DAF 24-valve could correspond to multiple engine families/years).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the engine serial/engine code plate (and/or stamped engine number) and the exact DAF engine model designation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the generic DAF 24-valve engine without confirmed exact variant compatibility.

risks.risk: Potential damage from transport/storage (bent lines, cracked housings, broken mounts). Photos show used parts but cannot confirm internal damage.
risks.proof: Close-ups of known fragile areas: turbo housing, injector seats, coolant passages, oil pan, and all mounting points—plus underside photos.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible minor damage requiring inspection.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine ID/serial plate and the exact engine code/model designation (not just “DAF 24 VALVE”).
Video of the engine starting and running (idle) or a test report showing compression/leak test results.
Photos showing all included parts laid out (injectors, turbo, alternator/starter, ECU, sensors, hoses/lines) to confirm completeness.
Close-ups of turbo, oil pan, coolant/oil leak-prone areas, and all mounting points.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a DAF 24-valve engine, but there’s no proof it’s complete or running/healthy. To price safely in Oyo, the exact engine code and running/test evidence are needed.
